projectName: Native Image Ads — CBD Oil Drops (Anxiety)
description: 10 belief-violation native image ads driving to 5 Reasons Why Calming Your Nervous System Won't Fix Your Anxiety. Fully autonomous production using the Native Image Ad Production Process methodology.
funnelHeadline: 5 Reasons Why Calming Your Nervous System Won't Fix Your Anxiety

env.OPENAI_API_KEY: Required for US-005 image generation. Must be exported before launching Ralph. Find in methodologies/shirt-swap-openai.md or .claude/settings.local.json.

expressionBank.description: Master list of 40 opener expressions organized by 10 angles. Each expression attacks the ONE belief: 'If I just practice calming techniques consistently enough, my anxiety will finally go away.' All expressions are congruent with the funnel's depletion frame.
expressionBank.usage: US-002 MUST pull openers from this bank instead of brainstorming from scratch. For 10 ads, select 1 expression per angle. Used expression numbers are tracked in batch-history.md.

batchHistory.description: Tracks which expression numbers, evidence sections, and image concepts have been used across all batches. Updated after each batch completes (append in US-006).
batchHistory.usage: US-001 loads this file first to understand what has already been produced. US-002 checks it to avoid reusing expressions. US-003 checks it to avoid reusing evidence section combinations. US-004 checks it to avoid reusing image concepts.

stories.title: Ingest funnel and write context brief
stories.description: Read the full funnel HTML and product research. Infer the argument structure. Write the context brief with all components. Run the funnel inference self-check.
acceptanceCriteria: Load methodology file: methodologies/ad-creative/Native-Image-Ad-Production-Process.md
Load violation checklist: methodologies/ad-creative/violation-opener-checklist.md
Read the ENTIRE funnel HTML — not first 200 lines, the FULL document
Read all product research files

Write context brief to [outputDir]/artifacts/context-brief.md containing: exact headline (copied from H1, not paraphrased), core thesis, audience level, key claims with specific stats, broken system with quoted funnel language, product resolution, and 5-10 implied beliefs

Run funnel inference self-check: headline check (exact not paraphrased), thesis check (3+ supporting sections cited), broken system check (specific language quoted), belief structure check (each belief mapped to a funnel section that contradicts it), audience level check (evidence cited), resolution check (bridge section quoted)
Every belief in the list has a corresponding funnel section that argues against it — no guesses
Context brief is written to file, not just held in memory
stories.note: Context brief pre-created by /prep-native-ads on 2026-02-10. Includes full funnel analysis, 5 belief mappings to evidence sections (R1-R5), identity stance, visual world, and banned patterns.

stories.title: Select and evaluate 10 violation openers
stories.description: Select 10 expressions from the expression bank (1 per angle). Run mandatory self-check on each. Ensure all pass the violation tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/context-brief.md for beliefs and funnel context
Read [outputDir]/expression-bank.md for the master list of 40 pre-written expressions
Read [outputDir]/batch-history.md to see which expression numbers are already used
Select 10 expressions from the bank — 1 per angle across all 10 angles. Every angle must be represented exactly once.
Only select expression numbers that are NOT already used in batch-history.md
Each selected expression has a pre-assigned evidence pairing (R1-R5). Within the batch of 10, ensure at least 4 different evidence pairings are represented.

Run mandatory self-check on each selected expression in the exact specified format: OPENER, TARGET, READER REACTION, GOLD STANDARD (pass/fail), FUCK YOU TEST (pass/fail), TURN TEST (pass/fail with turn written out), FAIL PATTERN (if applicable), VERDICT
All 10 selected openers pass all 3 tests — if any fail, pick the next unused expression from the same angle
Zero selected openers are observations, category attacks, wise reflections, compliments in disguise, or what-critics-say patterns
All selected openers attack the reader's IDENTITY/BELIEFS (V2), not the product/industry (V1)
All 10 openers attack the ONE belief identified in the expression bank header — not different beliefs
Save full evaluations to [outputDir]/artifacts/opener-evaluations.md including selected expressions with complete self-check format, note expression numbers and their evidence pairings

stories.title: Write 10 ad copy drafts
stories.description: Write full body copy for all 10 ads following the 7-part architecture. Run mandatory body copy self-check on each.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/opener-evaluations.md for the final 10 openers
Read [outputDir]/artifacts/context-brief.md for funnel evidence and claims

Write 10 complete ad drafts following the 7-part architecture: Violation (1 line) → Acknowledge tension (1-2 lines) → Name what they believe (3-5 lines) → The Turn (1-2 lines) → Stack evidence (5-10 lines) → Land the reframe (2-3 lines) → Bridge to funnel (1-2 lines)
Each ad's body copy draws from the evidence section specified in its expression's evidence pairing (R1-R5). This is what prevents body copy duplication across ads.
ALL 10 ads end with the identical bridge line: 5 Reasons Why Calming Your Nervous System Won't Fix Your Anxiety: {url}
ZERO product names, brand names, product benefits, product claims, or selling language across ALL 10 ads

All evidence is CATEGORY level (mechanisms, stats, comparisons) — not product level. Two ads with the same evidence pairing must use DIFFERENT stats/mechanisms from that section — never identical proof.
Run mandatory body copy self-check on EACH draft in the exact specified format: product selling check, congruence check, 7-part structure check, copy rules check, open loop check, verdict
Every ad leaves UNRESOLVED TENSION — reader cannot close the loop without clicking
Copy rules: one sentence per line, line breaks between, 5th-6th grade reading level, max 15 words per sentence, no rhetorical questions, no emojis, no jargon, identity protection throughout
Each ad is 200-350 words. Process ads in sub-batches of 5 to maintain quality — do not draft all 10 in one pass.
Body copy for each ad could NOT exist with a different opener — it flows from THIS specific violation
Save all 10 drafts with self-check evaluations to [outputDir]/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts.md

stories.title: Design 10 image concepts and write prompts
stories.description: Design 10 image concepts with subtle contradictions. Run mandatory image concept self-check. Write generation prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts.md for the 10 openers and their emotional frames
Design 10 image concepts — each built around a SUBTLE CONTRADICTION from one of 4 categories: Object in Wrong Context, Quantity That Feels Wrong, Evidence of Failure, The 'Wait What?' Detail

Run mandatory image concept self-check on EACH concept in the exact specified format: concept name, description, subject type, contradiction (with category), Layer 1 (technical native), Layer 2 (context native — write the implied caption), Layer 3 (intent native — what do you feel?), opener match (emotional state not just topic), face test, stock check, verdict
ZERO concepts use people-as-subject performing emotions
All 10 concepts pass all 3 layers of the native test
All 10 images match the EMOTIONAL STATE of their paired opener, not just the topic
No concept would appear in a stock photo library
If faces present: removing the face does NOT remove the image's point
Check batch-history.md for previously used image concepts — no visual setup may repeat across batches
Each concept has a unique visual approach — no two look similar in a feed
At least 3 different contradiction categories represented across the 10
Write image generation prompts using the V3 raw iPhone UGC template with SPECIFIC ugly (not abstract descriptors)
Prompts use specific camera failures and specific environmental mess — no 'harsh lighting' or 'raw feel'
Save concepts, self-checks, and prompts to [outputDir]/artifacts/image-concepts.md

stories.title: Generate images, review, and build HTML mockup
stories.description: Generate 10 images with gpt-image-1. Run post-generation review. Build Facebook feed mockup HTML. Regenerate any failing images.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/image-concepts.md for prompts
Read [outputDir]/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts.md for copy
Create or update generate_anxiety_images.py using maggie-funnels/generate_maggie_images.py as template
Set model to gpt-image-1, quality to medium
Generate all 10 images in sub-batches of 5 (API rate limits)

Run mandatory post-generation image review on EACH image in the exact specified format: cleanliness check (5 AI failure modes — lighting, composition, surfaces, objects, color grading), contradiction visible check, phone photo test, scroll-stop test, verdict
All 10 images score 3+ out of 5 on cleanliness check
If any image fails: regenerate with specific ugly prompts, lower quality, or escalation path
Build ad-mockups.html using maggie-funnels/ad-mockups.html as template
Customize: brand color hex (#449344), avatar letter (G), brand name (Green Valley Nutrition), domain (greenvalleynutrition.com), funnel headline
Each ad card: draft label with angle name + expression number, post header, collapsible copy with 'See more', generated image with prompt overlay, link preview with funnel headline, CTA row
Save post-generation reviews to [outputDir]/artifacts/image-review.md
ad-mockups.html renders correctly with all 10 ad cards and images

stories.title: Final set review
stories.description: Run the mandatory final set review across all 10 ads as a complete unit. Fix any issues found.
acceptanceCriteria: Read all artifact files for full context
Run mandatory final set review in the exact specified format:
ANGLE DIVERSITY: All 10 angles represented (1 each for 10-ad batch). No redundant messaging.
EVIDENCE DIVERSITY: At least 4 of 5 evidence sections (R1-R5) represented. No two ads with same evidence pairing use identical stats/mechanisms.
IMAGE DIVERSITY: 10 visually distinct images. No two look similar in a feed. 3+ contradiction categories. Mix of settings. No image concept repeats from batch-history.md.
TONE CONSISTENCY: Same voice, reading level, sentence length, emotional register across all 10.
NO-SELL FINAL SCAN: Zero product mentions, brand names, or selling language across the ENTIRE set.
BRIDGE CONSISTENCY: All 10 ads end with the identical bridge line.
BODY COPY DEDUP: No two ads share >40% identical sentences. If overlap found, rewrite the later ad using different proof from its evidence section.
All 7 boxes in the set verdict checklist are checked
If any box unchecked: fix the issue and re-run the relevant checks
Save final set review to [outputDir]/artifacts/final-set-review.md
Final deliverables confirmed: ad-mockups.html, generate_anxiety_images.py, generated_ad_images/ with 10 images, artifacts/ with all checkpoint files

Append this batch to [outputDir]/batch-history.md: batch number, expression numbers used (with angles), evidence sections used per ad, image concept names and contradiction types, image settings/locations. Update the 'Available Expression Numbers' list to remove used numbers.
